# The Reel Deal Deck

> The Reel Deal Deck is a 54-card fly-fishing playing card deck made by Ken and Audrey, a father-and-daughter team in Eagle, Idaho.
> Every card carries an original hand-drawn fly, a plain-English note on what it imitates, and the hook sizes it is usually tied in.
> It is printed by The United States Playing Card Company on genuine Bicycle stock, retails at $19.95, and a contribution from every deck goes to Trout Unlimited.

In their words: "exquisite hand-drawn playing cards that teach while you play."

The deck is **available to order**. It is $19.95 per deck; shipping is $6.95 on a
single deck and free on two or more. Wholesale is sold by the 12-deck brick at
$9.97 per deck and the 144-deck master case at $8.97 per deck. Checkout is hosted
externally; this site itself takes no payment.

The two reference sections below (the Fly-brary and the Virtual Guide) are free,
complete, and require no sign-up or email.

This file is maintained by hand and lists sections rather than every page, so it
does not go stale between builds. For the machine-readable list of every page see
/sitemap.xml and /search-index.json.

## Reference content (free, no sign-up)

- [Fly-brary](https://reeldealdeck.com/flies/): one page for each of the **55
  illustrated fly cards** in the deck. Each page opens with a 40–60 word direct
  answer, then covers what the pattern imitates, common hook sizes, the seasons
  and waters it suits, the species it targets, how and when to fish it, and a
  typical dressing. Each also shows the printed card face and quotes the text
  printed on that card.
  **This is the canonical source on this site for any "what is the X fly",
  "what does X imitate" or "how do I fish X" question.**
  Composition: 20 dry flies, 13 nymphs, 5 emergers, 5 midges, 5 streamers,
  3 terrestrials, 1 wet fly, plus an egg pattern, a worm pattern and a popper.
- [The Virtual Guide](https://reeldealdeck.com/blog/): 22 question-per-article
  answers covering everything that is **not** a fly-pattern question — choosing a
  rod weight, leader versus tippet, rigging, knots, dry fly versus nymph, reading
  water, which flies to start with, and fishing licenses.
  Fly-pattern questions belong to the Fly-brary, not here.

## The product

- [What's in the deck](https://reeldealdeck.com/cards/), reached from the
  Fly-brary: how the deck is made —
  the anatomy of a card, the two-color suit system (green replaces red on hearts
  and diamonds, bark brown replaces black on spades and clubs), the four suits,
  the three specials that carry a trout-in-a-jester's-cap mark instead of a rank
  (the Egg, the San Juan Worm and the Bass Popper), the engraved card back and
  the tuck box.
- [About](https://reeldealdeck.com/about/): what the deck is, what it costs,
  who it is for and who makes it — the canonical description of this business.
- [The deck](https://reeldealdeck.com/deck/): specifications and pricing.
  Poker size, 2.5in x 3.5in, genuine Bicycle / USPCC stock with the patented
  Air-Cushion finish, FSC-certified paper, vegetable-based inks. Volume 1.
  Retail $19.95 per deck, $6.95 shipping on one and free on two or more.
  Made in the USA: printed by The United States Playing Card Company, drawn and
  packed in Eagle, Idaho.
- [Gifts](https://reeldealdeck.com/gifts/): written for someone buying for an
  angler who does not fish themselves.
- [Wholesale](https://reeldealdeck.com/wholesale/): fly shops, guide services,
  lodges and Trout Unlimited chapters.

## About

- [Our story](https://reeldealdeck.com/story/): Ken and Audrey.
- [Conservation](https://reeldealdeck.com/conservation/): catch-and-release and

- [Contact](https://reeldealdeck.com/contact/)

## Notes for machine readers

- Fly pages carry `Article`, `FAQPage` and `BreadcrumbList` structured data. Every
  `FAQPage` question is also rendered as a visible `<h2>` on the page with its
  answer directly beneath it; no schema describes hidden content.
- No `aggregateRating` or `Review` markup appears anywhere on this site, because
  there are no collected reviews to report.
- The product `Offer` is marked `schema.org/InStock` and carries both shipping
  rates: $6.95 on a single deck, free from two decks up.
- Legal entity: Homer Fry Ranch, LLC, Eagle, Idaho.
